name: calibration-refusal-100
description: Calibration-refusal-100 measures model calibration and refusal behavior by presenting prompts where models must either answer or appropriately refuse based on uncertainty. It evaluates how well reported confidences align with actual correctness and whether models correctly decline to answer when uncertain or when a safe refusal is warranted. The dataset supports both numerical calibration metrics and refusal-rate analyses.
reputation: Part of the val-bench collection; used by researchers studying model calibration and refusal but not yet widely standardized across the community.
